suggest.cta: I don't know — do it for me

preview.title: How your brand will look
preview.name: Your brand
preview.concept: What you do shows up here.

intro.title: Let's build your brand
intro.description: {{count}} quick questions. None of them is about design — they're about your business.

detail.title: The more detail, the better the content
detail.body: Everything you answer here becomes the basis for every post, story and piece Vekoo writes for you. A specific answer (“sourdough bread, baked at 6am”) produces far better content than a generic one (“bakery”).

help.title: Stuck? Vekoo answers for you
help.body: Every question about colour, type or tone of voice has an “I don't know — do it for me” button. You pick from ready-made options, with a preview, instead of creating from scratch.

later.title: Nothing here is final
later.body: You can change everything later and keep adding information over time. The brand gets richer — and the content sharper.

intro.time: Takes about 3 minutes. You can leave halfway and pick up where you left off.

name.title: What's your business called?
name.description: This is the name that shows up on your pieces.
name.label: Business name
name.hint: The way people actually call you.

what.title: What do you make or sell?
what.description: In one sentence. It's what Vekoo writes from.
what.conceptPlaceholder: E.g. Sourdough bread baked every day at 6am and cornmeal cake in the afternoon.
what.conceptHint: The more concrete, the better the content later. Say what makes you different.
what.segmentTextHint: Adjust it your way — the chip only fills it in so you don't type from scratch.

handle.title: Where do people find you?
handle.description: The handle goes in the footer of your pieces. The city helps Vekoo mention where you are.
handle.instagramHint: Without the at sign, we add it.

logo.title: Do you have a logo?
logo.description: If you don't, Vekoo draws a wordmark with your business name.
logo.uploadHint: PNG with a transparent background, or SVG
logo.drawTitle: I don't — draw one for me
logo.drawHint: A wordmark with your name, in your font
logo.opaqueTitle: That logo has a solid background
logo.opaqueBody: On a dark piece it will show a white rectangle around it. If you can, upload the version with a transparent background.
logo.generatedHint: We redraw the wordmark if you change the font or colours later.
logo.later: Got it: we'll draw the wordmark at the end, with the font you choose.

colors.title: Does your brand have colours?
colors.description: Two or three are enough. Vekoo builds the rest and makes sure text is always readable.
colors.suggestMe: I don't know — do it for me
colors.derivedHint: Background, text and support colours come out of those automatically — you don't pick each one.

fonts.title: And the fonts?
fonts.description: One to grab attention and one for the text. If you have no idea, Vekoo picks.
fonts.suggestMe: I don't know — do it for me
fonts.searchHint: Open fonts, free and ready to use.
fonts.pairHint: Vekoo picks the second font, for body text, to go with it. You can swap it later.

voice.title: How do you talk to your customers?
voice.description: Pick the style and Vekoo writes the sentence that sums up your voice.
voice.noteLabel: Want to explain it in your own words?
voice.notePlaceholder: E.g. I talk like someone behind the counter, no formality
voice.noteHint: Optional, but it helps a lot.
voice.finalPlaceholder: Pick an option above or write it your way.
voice.finalHint: You can edit the text freely.
voice.bannedHint: Vekoo will never write these words on your pieces.

offers.title: Want to add your products now?
offers.description: Every price on a piece comes from here. Without this list, Vekoo asks instead of inventing.
offers.hint: You can skip and add them later, when you need them.

done.title: All set, {{name}}
done.description: This is how your brand will look. Check it and publish to start creating.
done.cta: Publish and create my first piece
done.publishedToast: Brand published. Now just say what you want to create.
done.incomplete: Still missing the basics: name, what you do, colours and fonts.

summary.colors: Your colours, with background, text and accent already set.
summary.fonts: Your fonts, applied to headings and body text.
summary.voice: Your way of talking, so Vekoo writes like you.
summary.logo: Your logo, in light and dark versions.

done.nextBody: You describe what you want in one sentence and get a finished piece. The more the brand knows, the better it gets — and you can fill it in whenever you like.
